notes: Read the complete target, preceding education context, all eight candidates and the review. Reattached graduate debt relief to the proposed college-affordability effort. Split the final compound so the historical leadership assertion remains factual while the requirement to continue leading in the twenty-first century remains a policy position. The six unselected candidates remain unchanged.

claims.claim_text: With John Kerry and John Edwards's leadership, making college more affordable would provide more college graduates relief from crushing debt burdens.
The United States has always led the world in mathematics and science.
The United States must continue leading the world in mathematics and science in the twenty-first century.
